[b]October 10, 2027: The Erjk Drs Plan[/b]

Secretary of Transportation Erjk Drs has formally announced that under the recent National Readiness Plan, the Department of Transportation shall be pursuing public-private contracts among the Estates to begin a five year overhaul of the national road infrastructure, citing long overdue maintenance and upgrades.

Under the Drs Plan, approved on October 9 by the Grand Assembly under the War Powers Resolutions, the DoT shall pursue the construction of a high speed road network system in order to remove inefficiencies with the currently 100 year old highways system.

In order to follow the precepts of the NRP, road crews and other personnel will be required to work 24-hour rolling shifts to be in line with the National Model of Efficiency, with Drs stating that by the end of 2028 most major cities and their environs should have fully upgraded and integrated infrastructure into the high speed roadways.

Furthermore the assembly has approved a major upgrade and expansion of the national railway network in order to prevent traffic issues with the increased military and industrial output under the NRP.

[b]Press Statement from Tiraki Diplomat Abdul Nazer[/b]

We, as the government of Greater Tirakan, express our grave concern regarding Shahban's recent expansion into territory that has long been understood by us as a neutral buffer zone between our two states. This development directly contradicts the spirit and the letter of the existing non-aggression pact, which includes an obligation to refrain from actions that could provoke, pressure, or hinder the partner nation.
Buffer zones exist for a reason. They are meant to reduce friction, instead of creating it. Shahban's move undermines an arrangement of relevance to national security, that was agreed upon precisely to prevent escalation at the current time, when theres tension in our relations.
Tirakan therefore formally condemns this action and requests that Shahban withdraw from the affected territory. We believe this request is reasonable. Just as Shahban would not accept Tiraki control over such a zone, neither can Tirakan accept its unilateral occupation.
It was our mistake to suppose, Shahban understands that these lands safeguard our bilateral treaty. Any attempt to alter their status, risks reviving tensions that both governments only recently worked to contain. 
We expect Shahban to honor the agreement made and to act accordingly.

[b]Statement of the High Emir[/b]

Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim.

The Government of Shahban has taken note of the statement issued by representatives of Greater Tirakan regarding the integration of the Eastern Highland Territories.

Alhamdulillah, the people of the eastern highlands have spoken with clarity. It was them, which have approached Shahban. It was them, which have contact us through their elders and councils. It was them, seeking protection, representation, and lawful administration. Shahban did not impose itself upon them, nor did it act in secrecy.

We reject the claim that these lands constitute a so-called neutral buffer zone. No agreement has ever defined them as such, and no people can be reduced to an empty space between states. Land without governance invites instability, land through god brings order.
Shahban therefore rejects the demand for withdrawal. The integration of the eastern highlands is a lawful process, undertaken with the will of their inhabitants and in full respect of our agreements. There is no option of reinterpretation, in signed documents.

We are mindful of our agreements, and we do not act lightly where peace is concerned. But agreements are upheld through honesty, not through assumptions. It was never agreed that Shahban must turn away those who seek our protection.
Shahban did not choose escalation, but to take responsibility, in the eyes of Shaytaan himself, bismi'llahi.
If others now feel discomfort, they should reflect on why order and consent trouble them more than uncertainty.

Insha'a-llah, wisdom will prevail, and restraint will guide all parties. 

The matter is settled.

Later, port authorities send a small flotilla of tugboats and a two large naval helicopters behind them. An attempt to tow the ship is made, however that doesn't work, they instead try to tackle the ship back upright utilizing the tugboats and the helicopter tow mechanisms. Which goes well. During that, head diplomat and famous Sikirskian marksman, James Khirman, together with his soldier-bodyguard march back upwards to the bridge. They spot G. Quagmire. They aim at him with his Ruger, then proceed to take him to one of the speedboats travelling with the tugboats. He is then privately taken to a port a bit further away from New Liberatska port. Then handed to "SSB". Afterwards they return acting like nothin' happened. [b]Идиоты....[/b][/quote]
Mr X and the team thank the Sikirskians for the help. However, it is clear that in this dark night, the ship will not make it to dawn. The ship began to slowly sink, even with the help of the tugboats, as it became clear to the rescue team trying to help crewman from the boiler rooms that they would be sadly stuck there until their demise. All of a sudden a few ropes from the tugboats break off, immediately causing the ship to quickly loose balance and start listing. Everyone began to panic. Already, hundreds of people were either flung off the ship or jumped in as the ship lost balance with the internal damages leaving a noticeable mark. It was a very cold night and due to the nature of the HMS Godiva, many people did have adequate clothing and could not quickly go down to wear more winter proof clothing, meaning that their chances of survival if the ship sank were very low.

Mr X says to the Sikirskians; "You know, I always thought that a ship of this nature was always going to go down like this" wile later adding "You see, the man you have taken away.... is a bit of a freak. There was an incident where he was doing some freaky manoeuvres inside his car when it crashed into a bus load of special needs children where it fell of a steep cliff in the vast countryside of our Empire. Since he's a court-jester, he somehow got away with it. Regardless, we hope we do not see him again and certainly hope he never comes back to the Empire since he will certainly be exiled for this incident". He later explains the the seamen of the Empire are some of the best sailors that due to the nature of the HMS Godiva, as it's a "pleasure ship", the crew were distracted and G. Quagmire managed to somehow get a hold of the bridge. 

Ship began to sink faster and faster and while the lifeboats began to leave the ship full of survivors, the chaotic nature of this journey meant that not everyone could get to them in time. Mr X, the rest of the Empire's diplomatic team and the Sikirskian Officials decide to board the last chopper off the ship and have the talks on land. Meanwhile, the ship during the sinking had managed to drag one of the tugboats into the massive hole left by the collision, running over and drowning hundreds and when it did reach the hole, the harsh collision and it being unfortunately the location of one of the forward engine rooms caused an explosive, rocking the boat side to side, causing thousands more to loose balance and fall into the sea. Many who were inside, especially near the explosion were killed and a massive fire started to take hold onboard the ship. 

As both the Balionic and Sikirskian officials looked on with a confused sense of relief and panic as the ship of originally of over 15k people was not only sinking, but had an explosion due to the tugboats being sucked in the massive hole and a fire caused by that slowly consuming the ship.

[b]Press Interview with Premier Arlan Vos[/b]

Dear Ladies and Gentlemen,

Following Shahban's public declaration and the direct talks between our governments, Tirakan confirms that negotiations have reached ground zero. Shahban has explicitly denied both the existence and the relevance of prior commitments not to expand eastward, despite documented assurances that formed the basis of the non-aggression framework that has been agreed on. 

Tirakan therefore considers the emergency agreement and the accompanying non-aggression pact to have been violated. While Tirakan has upheld its obligations in full and made no claims of wrongdoing on its part, the continued expansion of Shahbani administration into territories between our states cannot be reconciled with our prior arrangements.

As a consequence, Tirakan will no longer act under the assumption of cooperative relations, nor uphold the acts of the emergency treaty. Economic, financial, and logistical privileges previously granted to Shahban are being suspended or withdrawn. Shahbani assets and capital in Tiraki banks, as well as ownerships on Tiraki soil will be frozen for inspection, though the freedom of movement for civilians will remain unaffected. Trade relations established under the former free trade framework are terminated, and Tirakan will impose an embargo. Preferential access to Tiraki ports, transit routes, our cheap gas, development financing, and pipeline cooperation will cease fully. Ongoing and planned infrastructure projects connecting the two states are halted with immediate effect. Aviation access and overflight rights will be subjected to stricter controls. Tirakan further withdraws its prior guarantee of Shahbans sovereignty.

Tirakan remains prepared to re-engage should Shahban demonstrate a genuine willingness to restore trust through verifiable actions. 

This matter is not settled.
